notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Bastion of Remembrance's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
